blocks.text: Match preview: Nepal face Oman in 1st Semi-Final (ODI) on Thu, 10 Sept, 2026, 7:00 am at Bayuemas Oval Kuala Lumpur. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Standard ODI surface expected. Conditions will be clearer at the toss — monitor team selection and dew factor for night games.
Expected par score: 250–290 runs par score.
Thunderstorm · High 31°C / Low 24°C · Rain: 6.3 mm · Wind: up to 10 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
